findings.F1: Step 5's main measure lies on the side the idea predicts but falls short of the bar: a +0.64 % unusual 3-day move per case, 0.077 of the coin's usual 8.43 % move, t 1.89 over 503 cases on 341 days. This strength is in line with real ideas measured so far, about 0.05, so the effect looks small for this data rather than absent.
findings.F2: The effect is not tied to one coin, but it is mixed over time. On the explore half (101 cases) all four coins have a positive mean unusual 3-day move: BCH +0.47 %, ETH +1.01 %, XMR +0.73 %, ZEC +0.21 %, each with t under 1. By year the sign flips: 2019 is −0.68 % (t −0.96, 40 cases) against 2021 +2.61 % (t 2.12, 24 cases). So the market's own swings drown a small effect, which more cases would average out.
findings.F3: The grading fails at the plan's 3-day horizon, which is why the supporting check fails as well as the t. Step 5's size difference was −0.22 % (Welch t −0.38). On the explore half, the top forecast quartile (mean forecast 18.7) has −0.94 % against +2.28 % for the third quartile, with a Spearman correlation of −0.04 between forecast and the 3-day move.
findings.F4: The effect and its grading show more clearly over 5 days than over 3. On the explore half the mean unusual move is +1.48 % over 5 days (t 1.71, 95 cases) against +0.63 % over 3 days (t 1.01), and it fades to +1.06 % over 7 days and +0.67 % over 10 days. Over 5 days the raw scaled 7-day rise ranks the move positively (Spearman +0.13): its lowest quartile has −0.95 % against +2.57 %, +1.68 % and +2.23 % for the three larger quartiles.
findings.F5: More data is available than the test used. Thirteen more coins have daily bars in folds A and D, and partly in B and C: ADA, DOGE, LINK, TRX, UNI, AAVE, AVAX, SOL, INJ, NEAR, SUI, TAO and ONDO. This would add cases to an effect whose t of 1.89 is short only by its noise.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, a coin that has risen over the last 7 days keeps rising over the next 3 days, and rises further the larger its 7-day rise is in units of its 30-day daily-return swing.
ideas.consequence: An unusual weekly rise in a calm downtrend is followed by buying from holders who are slow to accept that the selling is over, so it carries on.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, a coin that has risen over the last 7 days keeps rising over the next 5 days, and rises further the larger its 7-day rise is in units of its 30-day daily-return swing.
ideas.consequence: A trader would hold a long position for about a week after an unusual weekly rise in a calm downtrend, sizing it up with the scaled rise, rather than exiting after 3 days.
